description: Zsh shell built from source with the MSYS2 toolchain (portable runtime)
notes: zsh built from source with MSYS2; zip served from the stable GitHub Release zsh-portable at https://github.com/raliclo/zsh. The 'zsh' shim points at zsh-loader.exe (a native launcher), not zsh.cmd: scoop shims for a .cmd target still have to go through cmd.exe's own parser, which can truncate a multi-line -c script at the first newline and mangle characters like | inside quoted arguments. zsh-loader.exe forwards argv to the real interpreter (zsh.exe) untouched. post_install then replaces shims\zsh.exe with zsh-loader.exe itself, which finds the install through zsh.shim: Scoop's generic shim.exe made Windows open a console window for every call from a caller with no console.
